summary: Backend-only verification of the deployment dependency-manifest fix (ModuleNotFoundError: click). New suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_requirements.py (21 tests) confirms: /app/backend/requirements.txt exists and declares all 14 required packages (fastapi, uvicorn[standard], click>=8.1.0, starlette>=0.36.0, pydantic, python-multipart, pillow, pytesseract, python-dotenv, httpx, bcrypt, motor, pymongo, emergentintegrations); uvicorn keeps the [standard] extra; /app/requirements.txt also declares click and starlette; both manifests are consistent (no root-only dep missing from backend manifest); no duplicate/malformed lines. Production install path simulated with `pip install --dry-run --report - -r /app/backend/requirements.txt` -> rc=0, click present in resolution report, no ResolutionImpossible/conflict/ERROR output. click and uvicorn import cleanly in the runtime env (click major >= 8). Preview backend still healthy: GET /api/health -> 200 {"status":"healthy","db":"ingrelens"}. Full regression re-run: 73/73 passed in 98s (21 new + 52 previous) including seeded QA login (ingretest@ingrelens.dev), register+login, GET /api/profile avatar present with partial-PUT merge, GET /api/barcode/3017620422003?mode=FOOD -> Nutella via OpenFoodFacts, POST /api/scan with only barcode -> real Claude analysis, OCR image scan, medicine/openFDA lookups, history ordering, auth 401/400 edge cases. No redeploy attempted, per instructions.

critical_code_review_comments: Manifests /app/requirements.txt and /app/backend/requirements.txt are now byte-identical duplicates; consider making /app/backend/requirements.txt the single source and having the root file use `-r backend/requirements.txt` to avoid future drift (deployer must support -r; verify before changing).
Dependencies are all unpinned lower bounds (>=); a future breaking major (e.g. pydantic 3, click 9) can silently break the production image. Consider pinning upper bounds or a lock file.

Regression suites: backend_test.py, test_new_features.py, test_iter4_deploy_regression.py, test_iter5_gitignore_envfiles.py, test_iter6_requirements.py (dependency manifest + pip dry-run). rca_of_the_issue: Original deploy failure: the Emergent deployer builds the backend image from /app/backend/requirements.txt, which did not exist in this Vite+FastAPI layout (deps were only in /app/requirements.txt), so the image got a stripped uvicorn without transitive deps and crash-looped on `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'click'`. Fix verified: the manifest now exists at the expected path with click/starlette declared explicitly and the pip resolver installs click cleanly; preview runtime unaffected (73/73 regression pass).
